summary: Thursday titles pass for India Maps: added 6 topics in core formats (re-measured 11,098 km coastline, Uttar Pradesh's ring of neighbours, Punjab's 1966 split, three north-east states on 21 Jan 1972, Indira Point, the two-hour sun gap) and queued one title challenger (a Devanagari search tail).
why: The upload queue is empty and no video has 48 h numbers yet, so fresh, sourced topics are the most useful work. In the niche scan's top 30, the on-lane hits name the search phrase in their titles (half in Devanagari), and ours don't. The scan backs keeping our question titles (median 25.8K views vs 10.8K).

findings.title: India's coastline re-measured: 11,098.81 km, Gujarat 2,340.62 km
findings.detail: Became the every-state coastline topic (priority high).

findings.title: Top on-lane titles name the search phrase, half in Devanagari
findings.detail: 'भारत का मानचित्र | राज्य और पड़ोसी देश' (548K, 3,964x); 'India Political Map | All States & Union Territories'. Queued as challenger im-title-search-tail.

findings.title: Scan title split: questions and names win, figures don't
findings.detail: Question 25.8K vs 10.8K median views; named place 17.9K vs 3.6K; figure 10.5K vs 15.9K (3,363 Shorts).

findings.title: Wikipedia's Uttar Pradesh lead says nine neighbouring states, its list names eight
findings.detail: The UP topic counts the states by code from the list, and the fact reviewer is warned.
